swayable.summary: A pro-Palestine activist challenges whether Jews are truly indigenous to Israel by pointing to architecture, Eurovision, and the destruction of orange and olive trees. Rudy Rochman responds with a warm greeting, and the exchange is conversational and debate-style.
swayable.title: Are Jews Indigenous to Israel? A Direct Debate
